mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delivery_gps_event (event_key, route_id, driver_id, device_code, captured_at, received_at, longitude, latitude, geom_crs, accuracy_meters, speed_kph, reported_by) VALUES (#{row.eventKey}, #{row.routeId}, #{row.driverId}, #{row.deviceCode}, #{row.capturedAt}, #{row.receivedAt}, #{row.longitude}, #{row.latitude}, #{row.geomCrs}, #{row.accuracyMeters}, #{row.speedKph}, #{row.reportedBy}) ON CONFLICT (event_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_key, route_id, driver_id, device_code, captured_at, received_at, longitude, latitude, geom_crs, accuracy_meters, speed_kph, reported_by FROM delivery_gps_event WHERE event_key = #{eventKey}
